$comment: Capability census owner map, read by bin/smoke/capability-census.smoke.ts. One row per item that bin/smoke/census/sources.ts lists. An owner is "current:<command> [words] [--flag ...]" for a registered command that performs the item today, "pending:<command> [words] [--flag ...]" for the command the CLI redesign adds for it, or "internal:<reason>" for machinery that is not a user capability. An item that more than one entry point issues lists each owner. The checklist covers prose sources the extractor cannot read.
